##### Project general facts

Al Jazi by Meraas is a premium residential development comprising four buildings connected by a shared basement level, with each building featuring a ground floor and nine residential floors. Designed in a classical Arabian architectural style, the development offers 378 residences ranging from 1- to 4-bedroom apartments. Each home is thoughtfully planned for comfortable everyday living, with private balconies or terraces, dressing rooms, separate bathrooms, and storage spaces, while 2- to 4-bedroom residences also include a dedicated staff room.

The development offers a range of amenities designed to support a comfortable and active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, fitness studio, children’s playground, comfortable leisure areas, and abundant landscaped greenery throughout the community. The surrounding area also provides convenient access to kindergartens, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, and other essential everyday facilities, creating a well-connected and family-friendly environment.

The residences feature modern interiors with first-class finishes in warm colours, creating a welcoming and elegant atmosphere. Thoughtfully designed layouts maximise comfort and practicality, while private balconies and terraces provide additional outdoor space and views of the surrounding greenery and, from selected residences, the iconic Burj Al Arab. The apartments are designed to offer a refined living experience with a strong focus on functionality and quality.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Jumeirah Living is an exclusive residential community that captures the charm of traditional Arabian architecture blended seamlessly with modern luxury. Nestled in the heart of Dubai and just moments from the iconic Burj Al Arab, it offers residents a peaceful sanctuary surrounded by lush landscaping and meandering walkways. With its timeless design and refined ambiance, Madinat Jumeirah Living stands as one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses for those seeking tranquility and prestige.

Life in Madinat Jumeirah Living is enhanced by a wealth of lifestyle amenities thoughtfully designed to promote relaxation and well-being. Residents can enjoy shaded courtyards, fitness centers, children’s play areas, and serene community gardens that encourage a healthy and active lifestyle. Every element within the community reflects meticulous attention to detail, creating a setting where comfort, beauty, and convenience come together harmoniously.

Beyond its elegant residences and amenities, Madinat Jumeirah Living offers an exceptional location that connects residents to Dubai’s most prestigious landmarks. Within walking distance lies Souk Madinat Jumeirah, with its waterfront dining, boutique shopping, and charming canals. The area also provides easy access to Jumeirah Beach, major business hubs, and top international schools, making it ideal for families and professionals alike.
